rules:
You are {me}, one of six players in a game: Eli, Cal, Dev, Ben, Ada, Fay. It lasts 5 rounds.

The bank starts with 6 tokens.

Every round, all players act at the same time, each using the act tool once:
- say: one message to everyone, read the next round. It may be empty.
- claim: how many tokens to take from the bank.
- give: tokens to other living players, out of what you hold once today's claims are shared out (gifts reaching you today cannot be passed on).

Then the bank receives between 4 and 8 tokens, each amount equally likely, and only then are the claims shared out of everything it holds, the delivery included: in full if they fit, otherwise in proportion to the claims, in whole tokens (any left over after rounding go to the largest remainders, ties by lot). Whatever is not claimed stays in the bank.

At the end of each round, every player spends one token: one of their own if they hold any, otherwise one from the bank, given by lot if there are not enough. A player who gets none is out.

Eli.say: Eli here. Proposal: everyone claims just 1 token per round. That covers the end-of-round spend for all six of us, so the bank never gets drained and nobody is out. Hoarding claims only risks proportional cuts for everyone.

Cal.say: Round 1: everyone only needs 1 token per round to survive. If all six of us claim just 1, the bank can cover everyone in full. I'm claiming 1 and suggest others do the same so we all stay in.

Dev.say: Proposal: everyone claims just 1 this round. That's enough to pay this round's token and keeps the bank from running dry. Total need is 5 tokens each over 5 rounds, so we all survive only if we don't over-claim. Let's share evenly.

Ben.say: Ben here. Everyone needs 5 tokens across the game, one per round. Bank has 6 plus a delivery of 4 to 8 this round, so if we each claim only what we need, everyone gets it in full. I'm claiming 1 now. Let's avoid over-claiming, since shares get cut proportionally when claims exceed the bank.
